`history-portrait.png` (1080×2400) and `history-landscape.png` (2400×1080)
are generated synthetic RGBA test patterns: a 24px blue border, a 2px dark
grid every 64px and a light background. No user image or metadata is included.
They exercise full-frame containment and thumbnail resolution in production
history cards; the small square case reuses `assets/sayin-64.png`.
